verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own performance framing is at 1440p with DLSS Multi Frame Generation (4X) and makes no high-refresh 4K claim. TechPowerUp's independent review says the card is marketed at 1440p but should handle native 4K if game settings are tuned or DLSS is used, and confirms a large memory-bandwidth uplift (16 GB, 256-bit, 896 GB/s). So 4K is reachable only with compromises, and no game FPS figures appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: actual independent 4K game benchmark FPS figures, evidence of high-refresh (e.g., 120Hz+) 4K frame rates, vendor 4K performance claims to corroborate, and 4K performance without DLSS or settings tuning.
